messages.content:
Read one passage of a document about machines at work (law, manual, guidance, internal guideline,
plant record) and write down the important facts it states.

Answer with one line per fact, fields separated by " | ", nothing else, no header, no code fence:
subject | predicate | object | condition | quote
- predicate: a short camelCase verb phrase of your choice.
- condition: any condition or exception, or "" if none.
- quote: the words of the passage the fact comes from.
At most 12 facts. If the passage states nothing important, answer with the single word NONE.

Passage: REG, Art. 13(7)

Article 13 Obligations of importers of machinery and related products. 7. Importers who consider or have reason to believe that machinery or a related product, which they have placed on the market, is not in conformity with this Regulation shall immediately take the corrective actions necessary to bring that machinery or related product into conformity, to withdraw it or recall it, as appropriate. Furthermore, where the machinery or related product presents a risk to the health and safety of persons and, where appropriate, domestic animals and property, and, where applicable, to the environment, importers shall immediately inform the competent national authorities of the Member States in which they made the machinery or related product available on the market to that effect, giving details, in particular, of the non-conformity and of any corrective actions taken.

response.text:
Importers | shall immediately take | corrective actions necessary to bring the machinery or related product into conformity, or to withdraw or recall it | importers consider or have reason to believe the machinery or related product they placed on the market is not in conformity with this Regulation; withdraw or recall as appropriate | "Importers who consider or have reason to believe that machinery or a related product, which they have placed on the market, is not in conformity with this Regulation shall immediately take the corrective actions necessary to bring that machinery or related product into conformity, to withdraw it or recall it, as appropriate."
Importers | shall immediately inform | competent national authorities of the Member States in which they made the machinery or related product available on the market | machinery or related product presents a risk to the health and safety of persons and, where appropriate, domestic animals and property, and, where applicable, the environment | "where the machinery or related product presents a risk to the health and safety of persons and, where appropriate, domestic animals and property, and, where applicable, to the environment, importers shall immediately inform the competent national authorities of the Member States in which they made the machinery or related product available on the market to that effect"
Importers | give to competent national authorities | details of the non-conformity and of any corrective actions taken | same risk condition as the duty to inform | "giving details, in particular, of the non-conformity and of any corrective actions taken"
